channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says renewed US-Iran clashes will not last ‘too long’
item.description: Iran's health ministry spokesman says the death toll from US attacks has risen to 18, including a child.

item.title: Republican senator calls on Trump to fire Secretary of Defence Hegseth
item.description: Senator Thom Tillis accuses Pentagon chief of 'inept mismanagement' as US military is strained by war on Iran.

item.title: Israeli PM says Israel is working to overthrow Iran’s government
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Wednesday that his country is working to overthrow Iran’s government.

item.title: Two Palestinians killed as settlers, Israeli forces raid West Bank village
item.description: Teenagers killed in settlers attack on al-Mughayyer as West Bank violence continues.

item.title: Trump suggests renaming Strait of Hormuz as Trump Strait amid Iran war
item.description: Despite renewed fighting with Iran and near daily attacks on ships, Trump says Strait of Hormuz is 'under USA control'.

item.title: Trump says US sees ‘everything’ Iran does, threatens further attacks
item.description: US President Donald Trump has threatened further attacks on Iran and says the military destroyed a mine-laying rocket.

item.title: Saudi Arabia condemns deadly Iranian attack on tanker in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Regional neighbours condemn attack this week that killed two crew members from the Philippines.

item.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
item.description: The kingdom condemns the targeting of Sidr, which was reportedly hit by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday.

item.title: Maltese tycoon acquitted of orchestrating murder of renowned journalist
item.description: Daphne Caruana Galizia exposed corruption and money laundering schemes in Malta before she was killed by a car bomb in 2017.

item.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
item.description: Iranian media reports two children were among those killed when shrapnel hit a home. Iran then launched missiles and drones at US targets in the Middle East.
